name: Spundscape Charades
description: Participants in teams of 3-4 will draw a secret Emotion and Location card to craft a 15-to-30-second audio clip using only non-verbal sounds and live Foley effects. In this dialogue-free challenge, contestants have 15 minutes to record a story told purely through gasps, footsteps, and sighs to keep the blindfolded judges guessing.
rules: Mode: Teams of 3-4 participants.;Setup: Each team will draw one secret Emotion and one secret Location card.;Execution: Teams have 15 minutes to plan and record a 15-to-30-second audio clip.;No Dialogue: Spoken words and explicit speech are strictly prohibited (only non-verbal sounds, gasp, footsteps, sighs allowed).;Foley Requirement: At least 80% of sounds must be created live using available props and surfaces.;Playback Protocol: During evaluation, the audience/judges will listen with closed eyes to guess the emotion and location.;Disqualification: Exceeding the 30-second time limit or using intelligible spoken words leads to point deduction or disqualification.;The judges' and organizers' decision will be final and binding.

name: Poem Writing Mushayra/Open Mic
description: Participants are invited to showcase their original creative expressions-including poetry, shayari, mushayra, and quotes-in Marathi, Hindi, or English. In this open-to-all challenge, contestants will receive their themes on the day of the event and must craft a performance that strictly adheres to the organizers' time limits.
rules: Open to all participants.;Participants can perform in Marathi, Hindi, or English.;Participants may present poetry, shayari, mushayra, quotes, or any original creative expression.;Themes will be announced on the day of the event, and performances must be based on it.;Each participant must adhere to the time limit announced by the organisers.

name: Movie Mania
description: Teams of 3 members will compete across three challenging levels to identify movies using dialogues, songs, and emoji flashcards. In this open-to-all cinematic showdown, squads must answer within the designated time limit to rack up points based on each round's specific marking scheme.
rules: Open to all participants.;Each team must consist of 3 members.;Participants must complete all three levels of the game.;Teams must identify the movie through dialogues, songs, and emoji flashcards.;Each team must answer within the given time limit.;Scores will be awarded according to the marking scheme of each round.

name: Behind the Clues
description: Competing in pairs, teams will battle through three elimination rounds-starting with head-to-head clue cracking to secure a spot in the top 15, followed by a high-stakes 10-second memory test to make the top 8, and finishing with a rapid-fire 45-second logo challenge to crown the ultimate champion.
rules: Round 1 : Crack the Clues;Teams must register in pairs.;Two teams will compete at a time.;Each team will get 5 chances to guess the clues.;The top 15 teams out of 30 will qualify for Round 2.;;Round 2 : Memory & Observation:;;Teams must memorize the given objects, colours, or sequences.;Observation time: 10 seconds.;Discussion time: 15 seconds.;The top 8 teams out of 15 will qualify for Round 3.;;Round 3 : Logo Challenge:;Teams must identify as many logos as possible within 45 seconds.;Each correct answer earns 1 point.;The team with the highest score will be declared the winner.

name: Carrom
description: CA classic test of precision and strategy, this carrom tournament welcomes both singles (1v1) and doubles (2v2) teams. Strike with accuracy, master the baseline, and strategically pocket your pieces to claim the ultimate prize-the Red Queen! Keep your focus sharp, avoid fouls, and outscore your opponents across the board rounds to win.
rules: Carrom is played as Singles (1v1) or Doubles (2v2) using 9 White, 9 Black, and 1 Red Queen piece.;The striker must be placed touching both parallel baselines or fully covering a baseline circle before hitting.;Pocketing the striker is a foul, which costs 1 penalty piece returned to the center and ends your turn.;To win the Red Queen, a player must pocket it and immediately cover" it by pocketing one of their own pieces in the same or next shot.;The game is won by the first player to reach 25 points or score the highest across a fixed number of board rounds.;Team must report 30 minutes before their scheduled match."

name: Corporate Roadies
description: Gear up for the ultimate test of grit and wit in Corporate Roadies! Teams will face an intense two-round battle: a high-energy physical challenge to test your stamina, followed by a high-stakes aptitude round testing your general knowledge, logic, and problem-solving skills under pressure. Strict discipline, punctuality, and fair play are paramount?show us you have what it takes to survive the corporate grind!
rules: Participants must be on time, follow organiser instructions, maintain discipline and respect other teams, no cheating or arguing with judges otherwise disqualified, judges decision is final.;Round 1: Physical Challenge tests fitness and stamina, complete tasks with safety.;Round 2: Aptitude Round tests GK, reasoning and problem-solving within time limit.

name: Concentration Test
description: Put your focus and reflexes to the ultimate test in this high-stakes survival challenge! Participants must stand in formation, stay highly alert, and maintain a proper distance at all times while closely following the anchor's rapid-fire commands. There are no second chances in this game, meaning one missed cue or wrong move will get you eliminated immediately. Outlast the competition by showing absolute discipline, sharp listening skills, and quick movements under pressure. The last player standing claims the ultimate victory as the champion of the event!
rules: Students need to stand in a line with proper distance.;Stay alert and follow the anchor's commands.;Miss your chance, and you're out.;The last player standing wins the game

name: Fly high, Stack high
description: Test your multitasking skills and coordination in the ultimate gravity-defying building challenge! Participants must keep a single balloon airborne using gentle taps without ever catching it or letting it touch the ground. While the balloon floats, you must use only one hand to rapidly stack cups and construct a stable house or tower. Absolute precision and speed are crucial as any drop or time violation leads to immediate disqualification. The builder who crafts the tallest, most stable structure before the clock runs out will walk away victorious!
rules: Each participant will receive one balloon and a fixed number of glasses/cups.;At the start signal, the participant must throw the balloon upward.;While keeping the balloon in the air, the participant must arrange the glasses to build a house or tower.;The balloon must not touch the floor during the game.;The participant may tap the balloon to keep it in the air but cannot hold or catch it.;Only one hand may be used to handle the glasses.;The house must be completed within the given time limit.;If the balloon falls to the floor, the participant is disqualified.;The participant who builds the tallest stable house or tower within a given time limit without dropping the balloon will be declared the winner.;The judges decision will be final and binding.

name: Blind fold
description: Put your senses to the ultimate test in this exciting, high-stakes blindfold guessing challenge! Working in dynamic teams of two, one partner will be completely blindfolded to face a mystery lineup of ten secret ingredients. Deprived of sight, you must rely entirely on your keen sense of touch and smell to decode each item. The clock is ticking rapidly, giving you a mere ten to fifteen seconds per bowl to make your guess. Bring your sharpest intuition and seamless teamwork to correctly identify the most ingredients and secure a delicious victory!
rules: Divide students into teams of two. ;10 ingredients will be given in small bowls/containers. ;Blindfold one student at a time.;Present one ingredient without revealing it.;The student gets 10-15 seconds to identify it.;They can touch and smell.

name: Hack the Clue
description: Put your mind and movements to the test in this thrilling, fast-paced treasure hunt adventure! Participants must race through designated game zones, solving intricate clues under strict time limits to unlock subsequent challenge levels. Mobile phones are completely prohibited, forcing you to rely entirely on sharp thinking, strategic organizer hints, and safe physical tasks. Discipline is paramount, as any cheating, zone violations, or damage to campus property results in immediate disqualification. The absolute fastest participant to decode every single mystery and cross the finish line wins the ultimate title!
rules: Maintain Discipline: Follow all college rules.;No Disturbance: Do not disturb classes, staff, or students.;No Mobile Phones: Mobile phones are strictly prohibited during the game.;Solve the Clues: Solve each clue to unlock the next level.;Physical Tasks: Complete all safe physical tasks given by the organizers.;Stay in the Game Zone: Do not enter restricted areas.;No Cheating: Do not copy answers or take outside help.;Protect College Property: Do not damage or misuse college property.;Follow Time Limits: Complete each task within the given time.;Use Hints Wisely: Hints are limited and provided only by organizers.;Follow Organizers: Follow all instructions and safety rules.;One Winner: The first participant to complete all clues and tasks correctly will be the winner. In case of a tie, a tie-breaker will decide the winner.

name: Error 404: Bug Found
description: ERROR 404: BUG FOUND is a fun, team-based coding activity designed to test participants- programming knowledge, logical thinking, debugging skills, and ability to arrange code correctly under time pressure.Participants will receive printed sheets containing shuffled lines of code with intentional programming errors. Their task is to arrange the code in the correct sequence, identify the errors, and rewrite the corrected program within the stipulated time.
rules: 1. Team Formation:;Each team must consist of 2-4 participants.;All team members must work together to solve the given challenge.;Each team must write and submit one final answer sheet.;Team members are responsible for submitting their answers within the allotted time.;2. Game Procedure:;Each team will receive a printed sheet containing shuffled lines of code with intentional errors.;Participants must rearrange the code lines into the correct logical sequence.;Teams must identify and correct the errors in the code.;The corrected program must be rewritten neatly and in the proper sequence on the answer sheet.;Participants must complete the challenge within the time limit announced by the organizers.;Teams must submit their answer sheets before the deadline.;No answer sheets will be accepted after the time limit, except at the discretion of the organizers.;3.
